description: Run a measured health check of a public website homepage: speed (server response, page weight, scripts, image formats), security (HTTPS, certificate expiry, security headers), domain registration expiry, email authentication (MX, SPF, DMARC), search basics (title, description, headings, indexability, sitemap), AI search readiness (structured data, AI crawler rules, llms.txt) and contact paths (tap to call, forms, analytics). Every result is measured, not judged by a model, and each warn or fail comes with a fix and an effort level. Returns a 0 to 100 website score, the top fixes, and how the page appears in a search result. Results are cached for 24 hours. Use detail "full" to include passing checks.

detail.description: "summary" (default) lists only warn and fail checks; "full" lists every check.

sections.description: Limit the report to these sections. Default: all seven.

url.description: The website to scan, such as example.com or https://www.example.com/. Only public http and https sites on ports 80 and 443.

name: scan_website
title: Scan a website
